summary: The window-and-quorum child question now has its own receipt at its own level (CheckRun 4dd05e7a3c6b4894ad3c7d66fe58a201), and all twelve comparisons resolved as they had in the earlier run of the same harness: local-type rejection at index 3, under-lease controls holding at 4 and 10, the peer-form MsgForgetLeader accepted at 5, the same pre-vote granted afterwards at 6, the repair heartbeat restoring the context at 7 and the identical pre-vote ignored again at 8, and the quorum stream carrying the candidate through an accepted message at 13, a granted pre-vote at 14, a granted vote at 15 and leadership at term 3 at 17 while the incumbent still reported leadership at term 2. I recorded the child-level account (conclusion violated, defect_claim asserted) answering both halves of its question: the suppression stays off only until the next genuine leader message, measured as one further leader tick producing the heartbeat that restores it; and one forged delivery to the other voter suffices for an up-to-date candidate to win the pre-vote, the vote and the leadership — with the same cause as the main account (the type is absent from isLocalMsg and carries no term, so Step treats it as a local message). Validation passed with no execution requested; remaining limits stay scope-only, and the index no longer shows that question without an interpretation.
